bio.en: Matthias Lau is a developer and founder of Heureka Labs, a Hamburg technology studio. He builds AI systems, robots and the [AI Router](https://airouter.io) for model routing, and researches knowledge graphs as memory for agents. He speaks at conferences such as code.talks and Future Coding Day. His own agentic software factory runs on three harnesses, Claude Code, Codex and Pi, and routes each task to whichever model fits best.
